questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’

are interchanged?

304 × 19 − 101 + 23 ÷ 5 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given equation: 304 × 19 − 101 + 23 ÷ 5 = ?

According to the question, after '+' and '−' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged:

304 × 19 − 101 + 23 ÷ 5 = ? ⇒ 304 ÷ 19 + 101 - 23 × 5 = ?

⇒ __**304 ÷**____** 19**__ + 101 - 23 × 5 = ?

⇒ 16 + 101 - __**23 **____**×**____** 5**__ = ?

⇒ __**16**____** + 101**__ - 115 = ?

⇒ __117____ - 115__ = ?

⇒ 2 = ?

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
The same operation(s) are followed in all the given number pairs except one. Find that odd number pair.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent

digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1

and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Option 1) 56 : 9

__**9 × 6**__ + 2 = 56

__**54 + 2**__ = 56

56 = 56 (LHS = RHS)

Option 2) 44 : 7

__7 × 6__ + 2 = 44

__42 + 2__ = 44

44 = 44 (LHS = RHS)

Option 3) 68 : 11

__11 × 6__ + 2 = 68

__66 + 2__ = 68

68 = 68 (LHS = RHS)

Option 4) 72 : 12

__12 × 6__ + 2 = 72

__72 + 2__ = 72

**74 ≠ 72 (LHS ≠ RHS)**

Thus, out of all the options, '72 : 12' is the odd one out.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: All of the letters in the word 'JUNGLE' are arranged in alphabetical order. How many letters are there in the English alphabetical series between the letter which is second from the left end and the one which is third from the right end in the new letter-cluster thus formed?
questions.solution:
Given word: JUNGLE

According to the question all the letters in the word given are arranged in English alphabetical order:

 
 

 Given numbers
 J
 U
 N
 G
 L
 E
 
 

 Arranged in English alphabetical order
 E
 G
 J
 L
 N
 U
 
 

Resultant letter-cluster → E G J L N U

The letter which is second from the left end and the one which is third from the right end in the new letter-cluster thus formed:

(Left end) E **G** J __L__ N U (Right end) → G and L

Thus, the number of letters according to the English alphabetical series between G an L are four i.e. H, I, J and K.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(66, 57, 48)

(94, 85, 76)

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent

digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1

and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

(66, 57, 48)

**__66 + 48__** = __**57 × 2**__

114 = 114 (LHS = RHS)

And,

(94, 85, 76)

__94 + 76__ = __85 × 2__

170 = 170 (LHS = RHS)

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) (85, 77, 64)

__85 + 64__ = __77 × 2__

149 ≠ 154 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 2) (81, 72, 63)

__81 + 63__ = __72 × 2__

**144 = 144 (LHS = RHS)**

Option 3) (98, 90, 83)

__98 + 83__ = __90 × 2__

181 ≠ 180 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 4) (79, 70, 59)

__79 + 59__ = __70 × 2__

138 ≠ 140 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Thus, out of all the options, '(81, 72, 63)' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
